segment 2: ring acquisition takes 7.00s of the 20s orbit, so its 360° sweep runs in 13.00s at 27.69°/s instead of the requested 18.00°/s (54% faster). A 30.77s segment would hold the requested rate — the acquisition is 35% of the segment and grows with it, so adding 7.00s is not enough. Staging the arrival removes the acquisition entirely.
